input.source: A valid vertex; empty graph has no valid source

output.path: Vertex sequence; empty iff unreachable; source path contains source
output.predecessor: nullopt for source or unreachable; shortest path need not be unique

constraints.errors: Invalid source/target throws; a reachable shortest distance >= UINT64_MAX throws overflow_error
constraints.overflow: Large nonoptimal detours are skipped, not confused with unreachable vertices; conditional reachability pass distinguishes true overflow
constraints.threading: Independent calls can share graph; result supports concurrent const reads
constraints.ownership: Returned distances/parents owned; graph need not outlive result

complexity.space: 12n result bytes + 8n indexed heap payload; graph/input excluded; overflow-only reachability replaces heap with <=5n logical payload
complexity.guarantee: worst-case traversal; no lazy heap duplicates

memory_lower_bound.scope: Conservative lower bound on owned payload, not a peak-allocation upper bound; excludes container headers, allocator overhead and caller input

evidence.correctness: Reasoned invariants in documentation; not formally verified
evidence.notes: Floyd oracle on random directed multigraphs; paths checked; true overflow distinguished from overflowing detours

provenance.implementation: Written for this project; no source code copied
